name: Gaussian Splat Shader Property Configuration
definition: Configures the material property block with splat count, SH degree, brightness, scale, antialiasing, transform matrix, and optional skinning/volume lighting data for the GPU render pass.
summary: Gaussian Splat Shader Property Configuration is a CPU-side method that binds splat data and parameters to a material property block, differing from other methods by handling setup rather than per-pixel evaluation or draw calls.
